meta.name: Flood in Nepal
meta.reason: On the 26 August 2026, a flash flood reportedly triggered by a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) in Nepal has caused significant damage in Rasuwa District. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
